## data

```{r}
set.seed(454)
# load libraries
library(tidyverse) #ofc
library(rstan)
library(readr)
library(bayesplot)
curling <- read_csv("curling.csv") ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
```

```{r}
## Complete Pooling approach

# Make data object
run_data <- list(N = nrow(curling),
                 x = as.integer(curling$PowerPlay),
                 y = curling$USWin,
                 z = curling$Points, 
                 m0 = 0,
                 m1 = 0,
                 m2 = 0,
                 s0 = 2,
                 s1 = 2,
                 s2 = 2)

# Fit model in Stan
fit <- stan(file = "C:\\Users\\wwh15\\Desktop\\STAT454 Bayes\\TR2\\techreport2-Bayes454\\completepooling.stan", ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
            data = run_data, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)


```

```{r}
print(fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"))
plot(fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"))
traceplot(fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"), inc_warmup = TRUE)
```
```{r}
## Partial Pooling approach
curling$competition <- as.integer(as.factor(curling$CompetitionName))

# Make data object
run_data <- list(
  N = nrow(curling),
  n_competitions = max(curling$competition),
  j = as.integer(curling$competition),   
  x = as.numeric(curling$PowerPlay),  
  z = as.numeric(curling$Points),       
  y = as.integer(curling$USWin),         
  u0 = 0,
  u1 = 0,
  u2 = 0,
  v0 = 2,
  v1 = 2,
  v2 = 2,
  alpha0 = 2,
  alpha1 = 2,
  alpha2 = 2,
  eta0 = 2,
  eta1 = 2,
  eta2 = 2
)

# Fit model in Stan
partial_fit <- stan(file = "C:\\Users\\wwh15\\Desktop\\STAT454 Bayes\\TR2\\techreport2-Bayes454\\partialpooling2.stan", ## make sure to set working directory to source file location
            data = run_data, 
            chains = 4, 
            warmup = 1000,
            iter = 2000)
```

```{r}
print(partial_fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"))
plot(partial_fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"))
traceplot(partial_fit, pars = c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2"), inc_warmup = TRUE)
```
